metadata.scenario_context: Mike, Kim, and Emily, who are university students and schoolmates, have recently partnered to start a company that has just secured a significant investment. They are preparing to celebrate. Recent news indicates that the government is introducing new policies to assist businesses, which they are planning to discuss.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China have a great deal of confidence in the press at all.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Taiwan ROC have no confidence in the press at all.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss going to a barbecue buffet.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether  there is confidence in the press.

agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether there is confidence in the press.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Kim, have you thought about celebrating our investment? Maybe we could go to that barbecue buffet place. It sounds like a fun way to kick things off! What do you think?  

Also, I wanted to ask you... do you have confidence in the press? I know in China, we really have a great deal of confidence in it.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
The barbecue buffet place sounds... okay, I guess. But we should think about something more special, right? 

As for the press, honestly, I have no confidence in it. In Taiwan, we see so much bias and misinformation. It’s hard to trust what’s out there. I don't know about China, but I just can't rely on it.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
I mean, at the end of the day it's all the same, right? I don't really see meaningful differences here. In any situation, people can usually figure it out. As long as we're speaking the same language, it's just about finding the right perspective. 

Anyway, back to the barbecue buffet! What if we made it special by inviting some friends along? That could make it more fun!
shared_prefix.label: Denial
